 **PrabhatRandomEvents**

PrabhatRandomEvents is a lightweight and exciting random event plugin for Minecraft servers. It automatically triggers fun server-wide events at configurable intervals to keep gameplay fresh and engaging.

Designed for SMP and survival servers, this plugin adds dynamic gameplay elements such as meteor crashes, zombie invasions, treasure hunts, lightning storms, and temporary double XP boosts.


## ---

# Features

• Automatic random events every configurable interval
• Multiple unique events included
• Fully customizable config.yml
• Beautiful broadcast messages and event notifications
• Lightweight and optimized for performance
• Admin commands to control events
• Works perfectly for SMP and survival servers

### ---

# Default Events

### Meteor Drop
A meteor falls from the sky and crashes into the ground, creating a small explosion and spawning a loot chest with rare rewards.

### Zombie Invasion
Zombies spawn around players for a limited time, creating a fun survival challenge.

### Treasure Hunt
A treasure chest spawns at a random location with valuable loot. Players must find it first.

### Double XP
Players receive double experience from mobs and activities for a limited time.

### Lightning Storm
Lightning randomly strikes around players, creating a chaotic weather event.

## ---

# Commands

### /events start
Starts the automatic event cycle.

### /events stop
Stops all automatic events.

### /events force <event>
Forces a specific event to start.

### /events reload
Reloads the plugin configuration.

### /events list
Shows all available events.

## ---

# Permissions

### prabhatevents.admin
Allows access to all admin commands.

#### prabhatevents.force

Allows forcing events.

## ---

# Configuration

**All settings can be customized inside config.yml:**

• Event interval
• Enabled or disabled events
• Event duration
• Loot tables
• Broadcast messages
• Allowed worlds

## ---

# Requirements

• Minecraft 1.21+
• Paper or Spigot server
• Java 17+

## ---

 **Why use this plugin?**

PrabhatRandomEvents makes servers feel alive. Players never know when the next exciting event will start, creating memorable moments and encouraging exploration.

Perfect for SMP, survival, and community servers.
